title: This East Texas Hotel Just Landed the #2 Spot on America's Most Haunted List
excerpt: Did you know the #2 most haunted hotel in the WHOLE country is just a 45-minute drive from Shreveport?!
content:
There is a specific building in nearby Jefferson, Texas, where I strictly refuse to step foot inside.

I’ve walked past it and stood outside its doors plenty of times, but actually crossing the threshold? Absolutely not. I’ve known for years that The Historic Jefferson Palace Hotel holds the title of the most haunted hotel in Texas, but a brand-new national survey just proved it might be one of the most terrifying stays in the entire country.

With Halloween spending projected to hit an all-time record of $13.5 billion, the most dedicated horror fans are spending their money on hotel rooms where the ghosts come included in the rate.

A recent study by Ace.com analyzed thousands of guest reviews across the country to rank the hotels with the highest concentration of reported paranormal activity in America and East Texas claimed the top spot right near the pinnacle.

Coming in at #2 on the national list is The Historic Jefferson Palace Hotel in Jefferson, Texas. Reviewers reported an astounding 65 paranormal mentions for every 100 reviews. Guests frequently describe creaking doors, sudden icy drops in room temperature, and unexplainable footsteps pacing down empty hallways. For the ultimate brave souls, visitors can even book the hotel’s most notorious attraction: The Doll Room.

The best part for local thrill-seekers? You don't have to travel far to test your courage. Jefferson is just a quick 45-minute drive down the road from Shreveport-Bossier.

The Top 10 Most Haunted Hotels in America

1. The Haunted Shanley Hotel - Napanoch, New York (120 paranormal terms per 100 reviews; haunted by spirits from the 1918 flu outbreak)

2. The Historic Jefferson Hotel - Jefferson, Texas (65 terms per 100 reviews; home to icy cold spots and the famous Doll Room)

3. The Historic Lizzie Borden House - Fall River, Massachusetts (61 terms per 100 reviews; guests report sudden lightheadedness and feeling watched)

4. The Stanley Hotel - Estes Park, Colorado

5. 1886 Crescent Hotel & Spa - Eureka Springs, Arkansas

6. 17Hundred90 Inn & Restaurant - Savannah, Georgia

7. Mizpah Hotel - Tonopah, Nevada

8. The Queen Mary - Long Beach, California

9. The Elms Hotel & Spa - Excelsior Springs, Missouri

10. The Menger Hotel - San Antonio, Texas
